Multi-Party Calls (MPC) — group voice rooms with dynamic participants

Usage:
  plivo voice multiparty [command]

Aliases:
  multiparty, mpc

Available Commands:
  create      Create a multi-party call (spends money — requires --yes)
  end         End the MPC and hang up all participants (requires --yes)
  get         Get an MPC by uuid or friendly_name
  list        List multi-party calls
  participant Per-participant actions inside an MPC

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for multiparty

Global Flags:
      --all                auto-paginate through all pages
      --dry-run            print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain            explain what the command will do before executing
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --timeout int        request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts

Use "plivo voice multiparty [command] --help" for more information about a command.
